about: Huntsville is a town in Muskoka District, Ontario, at the north end of the lake district where Highway 11 meets cottage-country corridors. Lakes, downtown shops, and resort amenities make it a year-round gateway to Algonquin approaches and Muskoka’s northern lakes. About 21,000 people live in Huntsville.
